title: Restroom Signage with Retro Typography
coreRelationships: Two distinct, horizontally aligned rectangular signs are stacked vertically, maintaining equal spacing.
Each sign contains a large, central, distressed text element ('GENTS' or 'LADIES') that dominates its respective sign's internal space.
A small pointing hand icon is consistently positioned below the main text, centered horizontally within each sign.
The overall composition is symmetrical along a vertical axis, with decorative elements mirroring each other on the left and right sides of each sign.
The background features subtle, vertical pinstripes that provide a consistent texture without distracting from the main subjects.
reuseFormula: Create two horizontally oriented, rectangular signs with rounded corners and symmetrical decorative elements on the sides. Stack these signs vertically on a light, subtly textured background. For each sign, use a distinct pastel color (e.g., light blue for the top, light pink for the bottom). Apply a dark border and fill the sign with a bold, blocky, distressed typeface for the main text (e.g., 'GENTS', 'LADIES'). Below the main text, center a small pointing hand icon or a contextually relevant symbol. Ensure all text and icons are in a dark, contrasting color. Add a subtle distressed texture to the signs and text to enhance the vintage aesthetic.
